responsibility: Declares the helper entry point that expands an AST::FormatArgs node into an AST fragment representing the runtime core::fmt::Arguments construction. It is the small public interface between builtin format_args parsing and the AST-building logic that materializes the final formatting expression.
same_name_distinction: Declares the narrow helper entry point for format_args expansion into an AST fragment. Unlike the paired .cc, it serves only as the public interface to that lowering routine, not the code that maps format pieces and builds core::fmt::Arguments expressions.
